Erasmus MC University Medical Center | 15 Feb 2025 | Multiparametric MRI Prostate

Clinical context involves an elevated PSA reading of 6.0 alongside a previously positive biopsy and a PI-RADS 3 designation on earlier imaging.

Prostate dimensions total 49.0 mL. T2 sequences highlight a 12 mm hypointense focus within the right mid-gland peripheral zone. Diffusion-weighted sequences exhibit moderately restricted diffusion paired with low ADC values, falling short of definitive malignancy. Contrast-enhanced phases reveal early, equivocal uptake in the lesion. Seminal vesicles appear normal; extracapsular extension and suspicious lymphadenopathy are absent.

PI-RADS 3. PSAD 0.13. csPCa predicted probability 0.7948016.
